name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 2 – Am 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 2a. Rejects the emergence and institutionalisation of parallel societies based on permanent religious or communal separation; considers that public authorities should remove policies and incentives which reinforce such separation and should instead encourage assimilation into national society and participation in its common civic, constitutional and legal order;
